Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Mohan Kumar Singh,Shailesh Kumar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pushpendra Singh Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Shailesh Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Pankaj Saxena,
learned AGA for the State.

2. The present application has been filed to quash to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.
3171/IX/2024 (State Vs. Sandeep Kumar and others) arising out of case crime no. 16 of 2024, under sections 498A, 323, 354 I.P.C. & Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police station Mahila Thana,
District Banda, pending in the court of IInd Judicial Magistrate, Banda as well as chargesheet dated 11.05.2024 submitted by investigating officer and cognizance dated 03.10.2024.
3.

sentences.text: In pursuance of earlier order, dated 23.04.2025, of this Court applicant no. 1- Sandeep Kumar and opposite party no. 2- Meenu Prajapati, are present in person before this Court.

3. It is jointly submitted by applicant no. 1 as well as opposite party no.2 that they have settled their Sandeep Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32951117/
1 dispute amicably and they have entered into a compromise.

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that they are living together as husband and wife.

4. Per contra, learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection that aforesaid compromise is yet to be verified by the court below, therefore, applicants may be directed to file aforesaid compromise before the court below for verification.
5. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction to the applicants to file original deed of compromise before the court below, within a period of 15 days.

In case, such compromise is filed before the court below, the court below will verify the same after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving the copy of compromise.
6. It is further provided that for a period of two and a half months or till the verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
7. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 of BNSS, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.

Order Date :- 5.5.2025 Saurabh  Sandeep Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32951117/
